overall_reason: A small named system (role colours with on-colour pairs, a --space-xs to --space-3xl scale used in 96% of spacing, two radius tokens, a media-query dark theme) holds the dashboard; type sizes are the one family left as literals and they run a pixel apart.

score.reason: T-SCALE-FIT passes for spacing and radius (on_token 0.98 and 1.0) and T-THEME-PARITY mostly passes; T-SCALE-FIT fails for type (13, 14, 15, 16px literals, TOK-003).

findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size uses 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 28 and 34px; near_duplicates chain 13/14, 14/15 and 15/16. The eyebrow is 14px, table account cells 15px, status sub-labels ('Stale 9 days') 13px. All 18 font-size declarations are literal while spacing and radius have tokens.
findings.before: Four body-range sizes a pixel apart, typed per rule
findings.after: Type steps as tokens beside --space-*: for example 12, 14, 16, 28
findings.why: Table text at 15px beside 14 and 16px elsewhere reads as three body sizes in one view.

findings.evidence: theme.semantic_colour_redefined_share is 0.824: --color-on-accent, --color-on-destructive and --color-secondary are not redefined in dark.
findings.after: Redefine the three remaining roles, or state that they hold in both modes
findings.why: Text on the accent and destructive fills may lose contrast when those fills change in dark.

strengths: A spacing scale (--space-xs to --space-3xl) used by 96% of spacing declarations; spacing on_token 0.98.
Role colours with on-colour pairs (--color-on-primary, --color-on-accent, --color-on-destructive), 90% of colour declarations via var().
Two radius tokens (4px and 6px) cover every control and card.
not_investigated: The dark theme was read from the stylesheet only.
The 'Powered by Vibe Rooster' badge (.vr-badge, its own slate literals, z-index 2147483646) is host chrome; left out.
Visitor mode inferred as Operate (an internal ops dashboard); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
